lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: MOM, DON'T OPEN THAT DOOR UNTIL YOU TELL ME WHY THE SWAT TEAM IS SURROUNDING THE PRINCIPAL'S OFFICE RIGHT NOW!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Relax, Nix, [beat] they aren't here for you, they are here to collect the servers because Principal Huda forgot one tiny detail about her dark past.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Lubna, stop this madness right now before you ruin your son's entire future [beat] and I make sure he never steps foot in a classroom again!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: You haven't changed since college, Huda, [beat] always hiding your mistakes behind a desk, but I kept every single receipt from that 2004 incident!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait, you two actually know each other, and [beat] why is the math teacher, Mr. Kamal, climbing out the window with a giant black duffel bag?

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: I told you we should have burned those files months ago, Huda, [beat] but you were too greedy and now we are both going down for this absolute mess!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Shut your mouth, Kamal, and get back inside [beat] because if I am going to jail for the missing scholarship funds, you are definitely coming with me!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: I told you we should have just gone to the PTA meeting instead of initiating a full-scale [beat] federal intervention on a Tuesday afternoon, Lubna.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Oh hush, Rafiq, [beat] watching her face turn that specific shade of purple is worth every single penny of the massive retainer fee I paid the lawyers.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Mom, you aren't listening, [beat] the officers aren't just taking the servers, they are looking for a folder labeled Disciplinary Protocol and it's in my bag!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: You little idiot, you just confessed to stealing classified school property [beat] in front of three police officers and a government witness!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Nix, give me that folder right now [beat] and whatever you do, do not let them see what is written on the very last page of that document!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Why is my name [beat] listed as the primary donor for a secret offshore account worth three million dollars and why is it dated the day I was born?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Some secrets are better left buried [beat] especially when your own mother is the one who buried them in your name to hide the evidence.
